title: Consumer contracts: tests/contracts/<consumer>/<provider>.yaml, and the provider's tests/contracts/fixtures.yaml
description: Written by the consumer (source of truth: its repo; the provider keeps a copy), run by the provider's gate (step 'contracts'). Runner: tests/test_contracts.py; documentation: the Standard, Consumer contracts.

family.description: Column type family: VARCHAR and TEXT are text, BIGINT is integer, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE is datetime, ...

provider.description: The provider's command name; the runner refuses a contract for another one.

provider_range.description: PEP 440 range of provider versions the contract applies to, e.g. '>=0.6,<1.0'.

env.description: Env var names the consumer sets; each must be in x-rb-env.

argv.description: Arguments after the command name; {placeholder}s come from the provider's fixtures.yaml.

stdout_json_schema.description: JSON Schema of stdout: only what the consumer reads; extra fields are fine.

stdout_regex.description: A Python regex stdout must contain (re.search).

offline_cache.description: true: the provider's offline data in place; false: none — the case must fail before the provider. No network either way.

fixtures.description: The provider's side of the `run` cases (tests/contracts/fixtures.yaml).

placeholders.description: Values for {name} in argv, matching the offline data.

offline_cache.description: pytest fixture (tests/conftest.py) putting the offline data in place: recorded responses, a filled cache, fake keys.

no_cache.description: pytest fixture for `offline_cache: false` cases (no cache), if one is needed.
